title: I finally made GARUM | Ancient Rome's favorite condiment
summary: Max Miller of Tasting History makes garum, the fermented fish sauce of ancient Rome, using a same-day recipe. He covers the history of the condiment along the way.
why: HN cites it in threads on Roman food and fish sauce as a hands-on demonstration of making garum.

quote.text: Worth a watch if you’re into cooking, or history, or both.
